notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We will be conducting a major update.
From October 2nd, 08:00 to 14:00 UTC
         October 2nd,  3:00  to 9:00 CST
During this period, game connections will be cut, and the game will not be accessible. Please disconnect in advance to save your game data.

⭐Gameplay Updates:
1.Nine new technologies will be unlocked at the fourth level. Players can unlock these technologies through normal research and complete related missions.

2.The score required to capture star areas has been significantly reduced, while the score gained from star area battles has been greatly increased.
Fixed the issue where star area battle scores were not displayed.

3.The points earned from winning 1V1, 2V2, and multiplayer co-op and challenge stages have been multiplied. Fixed the issue where these types of battles did not award points.

4.Guild tech points for each player have been significantly increased, allowing a smaller number of players to unlock a large amount of guild technology.


Since this update involves several services, the maintenance period will be longer.

Special thanks to the following players for their feedback on the game issues:
 [b]一半释然 灰lux[/b] 

Thank you to all the players who support our small team. It is your encouragement and feedback that allow this game to continuously improve and grow!

Wishing all Commanders a pleasant interstellar journey!

Sincerely,
MirrorAlice Studio

notes.title: Asia Server Launch & Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We will perform an important update on
September 12, 17:00-17:30 UTC
September 12, 11:00-11:30 CST

Due to network issues between certain countries, players have experienced frequent disconnections and rollbacks on the global server. To address this, we are launching a new "Asian-Russia Server" located in Guangdong, and the global server will be moved to Ohio.

As these servers are provided by different cloud companies, data cannot be shared between them.

⭐ New Server
When you enter the "Asia/Russia(AS-RUS)" server, you will need to create a new character. 
Your original data will remain on the global server, now called the "NA-EU" server, where you can continue using your existing data.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by switching servers and have prepared technology point compensation ⭐ which you can claim via mail (shortcut key M) to quickly catch up on lost progress.


Lastly, we have made some additional updates to improve the experience for new players and those replaying early game content. We appreciate your understanding.

⭐ Update Details:
1. Added a server selection screen, allowing you to choose a server each time you start the game.
2. Introduced more intuitive image guides (with more to come) to replace the current text-heavy instructions.
3. Reduced commander tacitc in early levels to minimize distractions for commanders.
4. Added "Decisive Weapons" to some early levels to speed up gameplay and help commanders get familiar with this feature.
5. In the guild page, the activity battles have been updated to "Custom Rooms & Events." 
   - Players can create custom rooms for fun simulations, PvP, or PvE by clicking the left panel and inviting Steam or in-game friends.
   - The right panel contains a task list that must be completed sequentially according to the main storyline.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/01677b90d4c8c23b658c615d4e5b3fb7359e97e2.png[/img]
6. Adjusted the server’s technology data storage to prevent potential rollback in research progress.
7. Made it less likely to accidentally click the same spot repeatedly in battles.
8. Added prompts for "Ship Deployment Button" and the ability to "swipe left/right" in the deployment panel.
9. Fixed chat issues in the guild interface.

notes.title: Star Conqueror is Launching Today!
notes.notes:
Star Conqueror is Launching Today! Prepare to Command the Galaxy!

Dear Commanders,

After countless days and nights of hard work, we are thrilled to announce that Star Conqueror will now be officially released on Steam! As a game crafted with passion by the small but dedicated team at MirrorAlice Studio, we’re excited to invite you on an epic interstellar adventure.

⭐Command Your Fleet, Conquer the Stars!
In Star Conqueror, you will take on the role of a fleet commander, guiding powerful warships and leading them through epic space battles. Every decision you make will shape the outcome of the conflict. Do you have what it takes to lead your fleet to victory in the vast, uncharted reaches of the galaxy?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/fbbc9b299218ae148bbd23390b4b88414f960d2b.png[/img]


⭐Design Your Own Unique Warships!
We understand that every commander has their own tactical style. That’s why Star Conqueror offers a deep, customizable ship design system. Build your warships from the ground up, choosing the perfect weapons, armor, and engines to create a fleet that suits your strategy. Whether you prefer overwhelming firepower or agile maneuvers, you can design the ultimate warship to dominate the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/29dd70b45557816fc347c41a196660788bffd86d.png[/img]


⭐Explore the Galaxy and Uncover Its Secrets!
Star Conqueror is more than just a battle simulator. It’s a vast galaxy filled with stories and secrets waiting to be discovered. Explore diverse star systems, interact with various factions, and uncover the mysteries hidden in the shadows of space, with star sectors holds secrets waiting for you to uncover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/cec51f02eeb0933507c15065f344351bbd41d782.png[/img]


⭐Rich Storylines for an Immersive Experience!
We know that a great story is key to an unforgettable game. Star Conqueror offers a rich narrative that draws you into a complex and believable universe. You’ll meet a wide range of characters, face tough choices, and every decision you make will have consequences that shape the future of the galaxy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/592532758b25f6247701d7b1bbef6335d8f50d6f.png[/img]


Are You Ready to Become the Conqueror of the Stars?
Star Conqueror will be available on Steam starting [release date], and we can’t wait to see how you, our commanders, will fare in the galaxy! Whether you’re a master strategist or a story enthusiast, this game will offer endless fun and challenges.

We want to express our deepest gratitude to all the players who have supported our small team. Your encouragement and feedback have been invaluable in helping us refine and grow this game. We look forward to welcoming you to this interstellar journey!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XZF6egdJrk]Join our Discord[/url].
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2913500/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

Wishing you safe travels through the stars!

Sincerely,
MirrorAlice Studio

notes.title: Open Trial
notes.notes:
Dear Commander,

      ⭐The Playtest is now available for immediate download without any approval! ⭐
        We welcome your feedback, and remember, the full version will be released on September 9th! 
       (Note: Player Data are not transferable between the playtest and the official release.)

        In this playtest, you'll experience the first half of the game's story and almost all the systems. Based on previous feedback, we've made several updates and optimizations, with more convenience improvements on the way. 

⭐ Star Map Trade & Star Travel
 ■ Skip trade settlement animations—complete trade orders instantly.
 ■ Fixed various issues like order misalignment and animation errors during trade, and corrected trade delivery rate display errors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/72b051e9475e4a1bb238a05f96c718c41a31a668.jpg[/img]
 ■ Accelerated star travel movement animations and hidden the left sidebar to prevent bugs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/fa5db97e80179c4c88b1974c1eccef13f530d1f3.jpg[/img]
 ■ Improved the interface to make it easier to view trade goods sales and demands in selected star sectors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/d15c55af97812f06036bf06b8ca22314d660dfbd.jpg[/img]
Planned Convenience Updates
1. Display available resources needed for selected trade orders to help players make better decisions.
2. Add information about which star sectors sell or demand specific goods in property descriptions.




⭐ Combat
 ■ Added a mechanism to prevent interruptions when deploying ships during the 30 seconds before battle due to ship selection.
 ■ Adjusted patrol combat objectives and the number of friendly and enemy ships, as well as battle time requirements to better reflect the actual time needed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/43db43ce52176b04fbb438dc539fdfb29f5a1b36.jpg[/img]
Planned Convenience Updates
1. After selecting a group of ships, hold right-click and drag to arrange the ships in a square formation.
2. Hold ALT + left-click to move the selected ships while maintaining their formation.
3. Drag the signal icon directly into the battlefield to release signals (previously required dragging onto the map).



⭐ Match Making
 ■ Player matching is now fully functional, reducing the chances of quickly matching against AI due to short wait times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/eee9e880949cc15cf5b7e722d74b548384658da7.jpg[/img]
Planned Convenience Updates
1. The matchmaking timer UI panel can be minimized, allowing player to perform other actions while waiting.



⭐ Balance Updates
1. Increased damage from debuff effects to better align with current weapon damage.
2. Balanced thrust levels across different types of thrusters, highlighting their unique advantages.
3. Improved the tracking speed of certain kinetic weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/0c72dec97732fbd5004b43d234558b121d692632.jpg[/img]

         MirrorAlice Studio is a small, 7-person indie team. Your support helps us grow this dream-filled game and unlock more possibilities!
        In addition to the current content, we're preparing two free DLCs, numerous ship updates, and additional mission voiceovers, all of which will be added once fully refined.


Wishing you a pleasant interstellar journey, Commander!
Sincerely,  


[url=https://discord.com/invite/XZF6egdJrk]Join our Discord[/url].
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2913500/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].


We've also introduced a quick promotion "Mail" to help you unlock ships and commanders faster in playtest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/445bb507056a89558305b008217ed7bda7294f50.jpg[/img]

notes.title: More Content In the Playtest!
notes.notes:
Fleet Commanders:
The Playtest has now been updated to access more content!

★ Star Sectors: Commanders embark on new missions to save the galaxy, traveling between stars to explore, trade, or complete tasks. 
■ Many missions require you to reach specific star sectors to complete them. 
■ You can buy and sell trade goods between star sectors for profit and use them to complete missions that influence these sectors. 
■ Moving between different star sectors may trigger exploration events. 
■ Influence star sectors to gain their outputs and special bonuses. 
■ Patrol: Engage in battles with factions within star sectors to acquire resources or unlock content.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/019a09f709ee478bca242acab6986d0f23763fec.jpg[/img]


★ Main and Side Task (One Third)
■ Travel to different parts of the galaxy with the missions of repel invaders, to experience more stories and adventures. 
■ Unlock more commanders and discover their backstories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/6ddd011c0de737c80510ce2aecf4112fd3420fa9.jpg[/img]


★ Trade Center
■ Acquire more resources more easily within each “Period” to support story-driven battles or PvP battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/1339733137b09012c3a045edf1db3546a27fd8f1.jpg[/img]


★ Decision Hall Unlocked
■ Make new decisions within each “Period” to shape your faction with more distinctive characteristics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/b64613fc29a717a6948f9512face6b4637f47512.jpg[/img]


Balance Adjustments:

1.Commanders now have more tactics. In addition to their original “Unique Tactics,” we have added some “Universal Tactics” for commanders. Although these energy tactics are less effective, they allow commanders to handle a wider range of battlefield situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/11b28e647d1a17788d64b9ee3be79022fa258b5c.jpg[/img]
After Adjustments (Below)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/ab6cfccc8d809fcba4d61b12ec5962658047ee28.jpg[/img]

2.Increased the damage bonuses from advanced technologies to weapons to prevent late-game battles from becoming excessively long due to high ship armor.
3.Enhanced the shield capacity of energy shields to ensure their expected defensive performance is on par with armor.
4.Increased engine thrust and weapon tracking speed simultaneously, making battlefield maneuvers more responsive and increase the importance of weapon tracking speed and accuracy.
5.Slightly reduced the damage of high-level tactical weapons.
6.Significantly lowered the difficulty of the initial levels in "Entertain Pub" and increased the number of deployable ships in battle.


Other Fixes:
Fixed a critical issue causing the game to freeze when creating a battle.
Fixed several issues with controls during battles.
Fixed some issues in the Star Sector trade interface.
Added interface navigation to the "Trade" and "Depot"

Additional Convenience Measures for Testing: 
There are two special mails in the mail system. One can unlock the first 3 rows of technologies, and the other can unlock the first 5 rows of technologies, as well as all ships and commanders. (However, this will invalidate normal story rewards and cannot be undone.) We hope this helps you experience the late-game content more quickly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/445bb507056a89558305b008217ed7bda7294f50.jpg[/img]

We invite all players to join our official Discord community and provide us with feedback: [url=https://discord.com/invite/XZF6egdJrk]Join our Discord[/url].
And engage with us in the Steam community discussions: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2913500/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].


Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in the vast expanse of space!

Best regards
MirrorAlice Studio

notes.title: Playtest Server Maintenance
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We plan to perform maintenance on the Playtest server and update game content on August 26th at  09:00 UTC. The maintenance and testing may take up to 6 hours, during which time you may experience issues logging in or be required to update the game.

Server Update Details:

Faster login connection speed and improved connection stability. This update will address issues where players were unable to log in due to UDP connections being blocked by firewalls.
Content Update Details:

We plan to release a significant content update on August 28th at 18:00, which will unlock the majority of game systems in the Playtest. This includes star map exploration, the first half of main and side missions, trading, and event resolutions.

For players who have applied for the Playtest, we will grant access after the update is complete.


Thanks.
